title: Cohen ring
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number. Here a *local ring* is a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal, a *principal ideal domain* is an integral domain in which every ideal is generated by one element, and a *discrete valuation ring* is a local principal ideal domain which is not a field (equivalently, whose maximal ideal is not $0$). A *Cohen ring* (with residue characteristic $p$) is a discrete valuation ring $\Lambda$ whose maximal ideal is $p\Lambda$ (so $p\neq0$ in $\Lambda$ and $p$ is a uniformizer) and which is complete with respect to its maximal ideal: $\Lambda$ is $p\Lambda$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], i.e. the canonical map $\Lambda\to\varprojlim_n\Lambda/p^n\Lambda$ is bijective.

source.place: Definition Tag 0327 (definition-cohen-ring, line 44872): 'a complete discrete valuation ring with uniformizer p a prime number'; 'complete' as in Definition Tag 0324 (definition-complete-local-ring, line 44786: R -> lim R/m^n is an isomorphism; here m = pΛ, so m^n = p^nΛ); discrete valuation ring: Definition Tag 00IE (definition-value-group, line 11987: valuation ring with value group Z), equivalent to (4) 'Noetherian local domain whose maximal ideal is generated by a single nonzero element' by Lemma Tag 00PD (lemma-characterize-dvr, line 29104), and (4) is equivalent to 'local PID not a field' (a PID is Noetherian; conversely by the last assertion of 00PD every nonzero element is u·π^n, so every nonzero ideal is (π^n))

mathlib_match.how: one declaration per clause, for a commutative ring Λ with [IsDomain Λ] and p with Nat.Prime p: (i) 'local PID not a field' = `IsDiscreteValuationRing Λ` (Mathlib/RingTheory/DiscreteValuationRing/Basic.lean:58-60: extends IsPrincipalIdealRing, IsLocalRing, field not_a_field' : maximalIdeal Λ ≠ ⊥; 'not a field' iff maximalIdeal ≠ ⊥ by IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq, Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/MaximalIdeal/Basic.lean:86); (ii) uniformizer p = `maximalIdeal Λ = Ideal.span {(p : Λ)}`, equivalently `Irreducible (p : Λ)` by IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer (Basic.lean:93); (iii) completeness = `IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal Λ) Λ` (Mathlib/RingTheory/AdicCompletion/Basic.lean:56, @[stacks 0317]), equal to bijectivity of Λ -> lim Λ/m^n by IsAdicComplete.of_bijective_iff (line 647), which is the match of def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring. The node's own text is this conjunction clause for clause. Not recorded as a leaf because Stacks 0327 means 'discrete valuation ring' in the sense of 00IE (valuation ring with value group Z); its agreement with Mathlib's local-PID definition is Lemma 00PD (with 00II), a theorem beyond one line (in Mathlib partly as IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE, Mathlib/RingTheory/DiscreteValuationRing/TFAE.lean:210, whose second item is ValuationRing, not value group Z).

lean.statement: def IsCohenRing (p : ℕ) (R : Type v) [CommRing R] : Prop
lean.note: The old mathlib_match names separate DVR and completeness clauses, not a Cohen-ring predicate. This module combines exactly those clauses, including primality and the maximal-ideal equality, using Mathlib IsDomain, IsDiscreteValuationRing and IsAdicComplete. The definition does not replace any of those notions.
